newsitem.title: GERMANY: Entire German broker team to move to Cantor - report.
newsitem.headline: Entire German broker team to move to Cantor - report.

text.p: The entire bond trading team at a Frankfurt brokerage have staged a simultaneous walk-out and apparently intend to join the U.S. bond house Cantor Fitzgerald, a German weekly magazine said on Wednesday.
The magazine "Boerse Online" said 27 bond traders had given notice at Finacor Rabe and Partner in Frankfurt after the recent takeover of 50 percent of the firm by Finacor, the large French brokerage.
Finacor Rabe and Partner would not comment on the report and nobody at Cantor Fitzgerald was immediately available.

In a press release issued ahead of the Wednesday publication of Boerse Online, the magazine said the Finacor management had held a hastily called meeting to discuss the crisis and had decided to insist that a notice-period of six-months is strictly enforced.
